title: Jazz Ensemble

title: Collegium Musicum: Musica Antiqua

title: Viola Choir
description: The Viola Choir studies literature written or arranged for viola ensemble, perfecting elements of technique, intonation and interpretation. Works prepared by the Viola Choir will be performed in public and in studio recitals.
prerequisites_raw: Enrollment by audition. Upper-division standing.

title: Cello Choir
description: The cello choir studies cello literature in depth, including duos, trios, quartets and larger cello ensemble works. Cellists work together on blend of sound, perfecting technique and intonation, as well as balance.The choir will prepare works for public performances.
prerequisites_raw: Audition.

title: Ethnomusicology Ensemble: American Folk Music
description: The study of English-language folk music, emanating from the southeastern United States, focusing on the string band music usually called "old-time,"and the distinct but related style of "bluegrass." These traditions are related to commerical genres known as "country."
prerequisites_raw: Enrollment by audition. For upper-division students only.

title: Afro-Brazilian Ensemble
description: The ensemble will study a variety of Brazilian musical forms sharing a strong African influence with complex layers of interlocking syncopation, melodies emerging from the alternation of various drums, and a distinctively heavy swing.

title: Young Soloists Ensemble
description: A small, select vocal ensemble specialized in one- or two-on-a-part singing. Requires concurrent enrollment in MUS A 236, MUS A 237 or MUS A 237M.
prerequisites_raw: Enrollment by audition. Requires concurrent enrollment in MUS A 236, MUS A 237 or MUS A 237M.

title: Wind Ensemble
description: Masterworks of the literature for ensembles smaller than orchestral or fullband scoring. Although the basic ensembles feature winds, both strings and percussion are utilized. Advanced players only.
prerequisites_raw: Entrance by audition.

title: UCSB Chamber Choir
description: A select ensemble of voice majors and non-majors, the Chamber Choir prepares musicians for professional ensemble work and offers advanced study in choral literature, techniques, styles and interpretation covering five centuries of choral repertoire.
prerequisites_raw: Enrollment by audition.

title: UCSB Lumina
description: This chorus studies and performs the main repertory for treble voices, from Renaissance to 21st Century. Occasionally undertakes collaboration with other UCSB choirs and community entities. No audition required.

title: UCSB Singing Gauchos
description: The UCSB Singing Gauchos is a tenor and bass choir performing fine choral literature representative of various style periods and vocal techniques from the global choral tradition. Regular performances on and off campus.

title: Opera Workshop
description: Participation in opera scenes.
prerequisites_raw: Audition.

title: Opera Production
description: Participation in annual opera production.
prerequisites_raw: Audition.

title: Opera Outreach
description: The Opera Outreach Program is the touring performance of a staged opera scene by advanced voice students from UCSB's Department of Music, presented to various high schools and community choirs in the Santa Barbara Area and beyond.Students (and their understudies) will learn and rehearse an operatic scene in the first 5-7 weeks of the Spring Quarter. Once they are memorized, staged, and choreographed, the outreach performances (in full costume/make-up) begin in the last weeks of the quarter.

title: The Fundamentals of Popular Guitar
description: A skills course designed for developing guitar technique used in folk, rock, blues, classical and jazz styles. The curriculum focuses on strumming patterns, finger picking, chords and their voicings, riffs and soloing. Emphasis is on learning to play songs by ear. Neck geography is taught through relational patterns of scales and modes. All guitar types (acoustic, classical, electric) are welcome, though acoustic/ classical are preferred. Accommodates a variety of playing levels, from complete beginner to intermediate-advanced shredders and classical players, and everything in-between. Guitar to be provided by the student.
prerequisites_raw: Enrollment by audition.

title: Ensemble for Contemporary Music
description: Reading sessions and preparation for performanc of contemporary music. There are one or two concerts each quarter. Includes departmental scholarship players, and is open to composers who also perform.
prerequisites_raw: Enrollment by audition; graduate students only.
